data.name: OKUBI
data.detailed_description:
Join our Discord!


About the Game

COMPETE IN FAST-PACED 1V1, 2V2 & 3V3 ARENAS

Enter competitive arenas built around fast engagements, teamwork, mechanical skill, and clutch plays.

Fight in intense 1v1 duels, coordinated 2v2 matches, and competitive 3v3 battles where every movement, attack, dodge, and positioning decision matters. Matches are quick to understand but difficult to master, rewarding players who learn their class, adapt to their opponents, and execute under pressure.

Whether you are chasing the ranked ladder or jumping into matches with friends, OKUBI's arenas are designed to deliver high-intensity PvP without unnecessary downtime.

MASTER GROUND & AERIAL COMBAT WITH A UNIQUE WINGED COMBAT SYSTEM

OKUBI combines fast ground combat with fully integrated aerial movement, creating fights that can instantly shift between the floor and the sky. Deploy your wings to gain vertical mobility, reposition above enemies, dodge incoming attacks, chase fleeing opponents, or strike from unexpected angles before diving back into close-range combat.

Chain abilities, manage your movement, react to enemy attacks, and transition smoothly between air and ground.

The fundamentals are easy to understand, but mastering movement, positioning, timing, combos, and aerial engagements creates a high skill ceiling built for competitive play.

MEET PLAYERS IN EXPLORABLE PUBLIC HUBS

Between battles, return to a lively public social hub filled with players, activity, and everything you need to prepare for your next deployment. Meet other players, form squads, visit traders, access crafting and upgrade stations, experiment with your build, take on activities, or simply hang out between matches. The hub is the heart of OKUBI — a shared space where players meet, prepare, compete, and build their reputation before heading back into the fight.

CREATE YOUR OWN BUILD & COMBAT PLAYSTYLE

Customize the way your character fights through gear, stats, elemental effects, modifiers, and conditional combat bonuses. Shape a build around aggressive pressure, mobility, survivability, ability power, precision, or specialized combinations that complement your class and preferred playstyle. OKUBI's Five Elements expand those possibilities even further, allowing you to unlock elemental effects and triggers that influence how your abilities interact during combat.

Every choice affects how your character plays, giving you room to experiment, optimize, and create a build that feels distinctly yours.

CRAFT, UPGRADE & REFINE YOUR GEAR

Collect rare minerals, energy sources, blueprints, resources, and exotic technology throughout the world, then bring them back to upgrade and refine your equipment. Craft new gear, improve existing equipment, modify your loadout, and turn valuable resources into meaningful progression. The strongest equipment isn't simply handed to you — it comes from exploration, successful deployments, smart decisions, and careful investment in your build.

What you bring home determines what you can create next.

VENTURE INTO DANGEROUS OPEN-WORLD PvP ZONES

Leave the safety of the hub and enter larger contested regions where squads compete over valuable resources, rare loot, moving objectives, caravans, and extraction opportunities.

These zones introduce a different kind of pressure from the arenas. Encounters are less predictable, objectives can shift, and another squad can appear when you least expect it.

Yōkai disturbances and dynamic world events can transform parts of the battlefield, creating new threats and opportunities during a deployment.

Choose your fights carefully, secure what you came for, and make it back with your rewards.

TAKE ON QUESTS, MISSIONS & WORLD EVENTS

Accept quests and missions that send you into dangerous territories, contested regions, and evolving conflicts throughout the world of OKUBI.

Discover new locations, encounter unusual enemies, participate in dynamic events, uncover pieces of the world's lore, and earn rewards that help you progress.

Some missions will test your combat abilities. Others will push you to explore, survive, cooperate, or take risks in places where other players may be pursuing the same objective.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER & PROGRESSION

Build an identity that reflects how you want to play.

Develop your character, improve equipment, unlock new combat options, experiment with elemental combinations, and refine your loadout as you discover new strategies.

Your progression gives you more ways to specialize and experiment while keeping player skill, decision-making, and mastery at the center of combat.

HELP SHAPE OKUBI WITH THE COMMUNITY

OKUBI is being built by a passionate solo developer with development shaped closely alongside its players.

Join the Discord community to follow development, participate in playtests, share direct feedback, discuss new systems, and help influence the future of the game.

Development is transparent, collaborative, and constantly evolving as OKUBI moves toward its next major milestones.

The journey is just beginning. Join the community, enter the arena, and become part of what OKUBI becomes next.

data.short_description: OKUBI is a fast-paced PvP combat game where brutal melee combos collides with adrenaline-fueled aerial battles. Deploy your wings and experience razor-sharp control and unmatched freedom of movements in various battlegrounds and arenas.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Portugal, Italian, German, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 SP1+
  • Processor: Processor: Intel Core i7-3770 @ 3.4 GHz or AMDFX-8350 @ 4.0 GHz or better.
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX11 capabilities
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ASIO-compatible or high-definition sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or better
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ASIO-compatible or high-definition sound card
